english.title: Disclose confidential information relating to human fertilisation or embryology
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disclosed information

(A)_[relating to the provision for an identifiable individual of treatment services other than basic partner treatment services]_
(B)_[relating to the procurement or distribution of sperm, other than sperm which was partner-donated sperm and had not been stored, in the course of providing non-medical fertility services for an identifiable individual]_
(C)_[relating to the keeping of the gametes of an identifiable individual]_
(D)_[relating to the keeping of an embryo taken from an identifiable woman]_
(E)_[relating to the use of the gametes of an identifiable individual other than their use for the purpose of basic treatment partner services]_
(F)_[which showed that an identifiable individual was a relevant individual]_

in contravention of section 33A of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 41(5) of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: No proceedings for an offence under this Act shall be instituted in England and Wales, except by or with the consent of the DPP or in Northern Ireland, except by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions for Northern Ireland.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
